name: Airtable
tagline: Relational database platform for building project trackers, workflows and apps with automations and AI.
bestFor: Teams that want to build custom trackers on a flexible database
description: Airtable lets teams build bases of linked records and view them as grids, timelines and Gantt charts, with automations and AI credits included on every plan. The Free plan covers up to 5 editors; Team costs $20 per seat per month billed annually or $24 billed monthly.
pros: Read-only collaborators, form submissions and share links are not billed on Team and Business
Team includes 50,000 records per base, 25,000 automation runs per month and 15,000 AI credits per billable collaborator
Timeline and Gantt views are included from the Team plan
Native apps for macOS, Windows, iOS and Android
cons: Free plan is capped at 1,000 records per base, 100 automation runs per month and 5 editors
Business costs $45 per seat per month billed annually ($54 monthly)
SAML SSO is listed for the Enterprise plan only
freePlanDetails: Up to 5 editors, 1,000 records per base, 1 GB attachments per base, 100 automation runs and 1,000 API calls per workspace per month, 500 AI credits per editor per month.
trial: 14-day Team trial for the first workspace on a new account (120 days for .edu addresses)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 5 editors; 1,000 records and 1 GB attachments per base; 100 automation runs/month; no extensions or record coloring.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Per user with edit permissions. 50,000 records and 20 GB attachments per base, 25,000 automation runs and 100,000 API calls per workspace/month, 15,000 AI credits per billable collaborator/month. Credit card payment.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Self-serve price per user with edit permissions. 125,000 records and 100 GB attachments per base, 100,000 automation runs/month, unlimited API calls, 20,000 AI credits per paid user/month, two-way sync and admin panel. Invoicing available through sales.

plans.name: Enterprise Scale
plans.notes: Contact sales; unlimited org units, workspaces and bases; SAML SSO.

integrations: Two-way sync (Business); REST API with plan-based call limits

name: Linear
tagline: Issue tracking and project planning tool for software teams, with cycles, project timelines, docs and built-in AI agents.
bestFor: Software product teams tracking issues, cycles and roadmaps
description: Linear tracks issues, cycles and projects, with a project timeline view, project and team documents, and Linear Agent and MCP access on every plan. The Free plan allows unlimited members with 250 issues and 2 teams; Basic costs $10 per user per month billed yearly.
pros: Free plan includes unlimited members
Linear Agent, the agent platform and MCP access are included on all plans
Timeline view shows projects chronologically with dependencies
SOC 2 Type II audited and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified
cons: Free plan is limited to 250 issues, 2 teams and 10 MB file uploads
Triage rules and Triage Intelligence require Business or Enterprise
SAML, SCIM, audit log and HIPAA are Enterprise only
freePlanDetails: Unlimited members, 2 teams, 250 issues, 10 MB file uploads; Google SSO.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Per user, billed yearly. Unlimited issues, 5 teams, unlimited file uploads. Monthly billing exists but the monthly rate is not shown on the pricing page. Billed per unsuspended user.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per user, billed yearly. Unlimited teams, Triage Intelligence and triage rules, Insights, Asks, Releases (15 pipelines). Monthly rate not shown on the pricing page.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, annual billing only. SAML, SCIM, HIPAA, audit log, IP restrictions, uptime SLA.

integrations: MCP server access on all plans

name: Plane
tagline: Open-source project management tool with work items, cycles, timelines, pages and wiki, available in the cloud or self-hosted.
bestFor: Teams that want an open-source Jira alternative they can self-host
description: Plane tracks work items in list, board, calendar, table and Gantt-style timeline layouts, with cycles, pages and a wiki, and can run on Plane Cloud or be self-hosted. The Free plan covers up to 12 users; Pro costs $6 per seat per month billed annually or $8 monthly.
pros: Free plan allows up to 12 users
Pro includes 500 Plane AI credits per seat per month and Business 1,000
Time tracking with worklogs from Pro
Open-source core that can be self-hosted
cons: Workflows and trigger-and-action automations start on Business ($13 per seat annually)
SSO on Plane Cloud requires Business
Windows desktop app for the latest version is listed as coming soon
freePlanDetails: Up to 12 users, cycles, pages, in-app intake and limited guest access; no AI credits, wiki, time tracking or automations.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per seat; unlimited seats, 5 guests per paid member, wiki, timeline dependencies, historical worklogs, 500 AI credits per seat per month (cloud). No workflows or SSO on cloud.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per seat; single workflow plus trigger-and-action automations, worklog approvals, intake forms and email, SSO, 1,000 AI credits per seat per month (cloud).

plans.name: Enterprise Grid
plans.notes: Listed as coming soon; multiple workflows with approvals, custom guest roles, private and managed deployments.

sources.label: TechCrunch: Plane takes on Jira with open source project management tools

name: Zoho Projects
tagline: Project management software with Gantt charts, timesheets, blueprints and Zia AI, part of the Zoho suite.
bestFor: Budget-conscious teams that need Gantt charts and timesheets
description: Zoho Projects combines task management, Gantt charts, time logs and timesheets, workflow rules and blueprints, with Zia AI features included from the Premium plan. The Free plan covers up to 5 users and 3 projects; Premium costs $4 per user per month billed yearly or $5 monthly.
pros: Gantt chart available on every plan, including Free
Time logs and timesheets with multi-level approvals from Premium
Zia Insights, Zia Translate and content generation included on Premium
15-day free trial of paid plans with no credit card required
cons: Free plan is limited to 5 users, 3 projects and 50 workflow actions per month
SSO, critical path and baselines require Enterprise ($9 per user annually)
Premium support (24/5 phone and chat) is a paid add-on requiring at least 25 user licenses
freePlanDetails: Up to 5 users, 3 projects, 5 GB storage, subtasks, whiteboard, Gantt chart, 50 workflow action executions per month, iOS and Android apps.
trial: 15-day free trial of Premium, Enterprise or Ultimate; no credit card required

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 5 users, 3 projects, 5 GB storage.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Per user. Unlimited projects, 100 GB storage, 20 project templates, timesheets, task blueprints, budgeting, 5,000 workflow executions/month, Zia AI features.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Per user. 120 GB storage, 10 read-only users, SSO, 2FA, portfolio dashboard, critical path and baseline, sandbox, 50,000 workflow executions/month, all Zia features.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: Per user. 15 GB storage per user (min 150 GB/org), 100 read-only users, 100 resources, multi-user and multi-project timesheets, 500,000 workflow executions/month.

integrations: Zapier, Zendesk, Microsoft Teams, Office 365, Slack, ServiceNow, Dropbox, SharePoint, Figma, GitHub, Zoho CRM and other Zoho apps
support: Premium support add-on: live chat and phone 24/5, remote assistance, onboarding

sources.label: Zoho Projects pricing data file loaded by the pricing page (USD prices)
Zoho Projects help: upgrade from Free plan

name: Todoist
tagline: Task manager for individuals and teams, with projects, filters, calendar layouts, automations and AI task capture.
bestFor: Individuals and small teams managing tasks rather than complex projects
description: Todoist organizes tasks into personal and team projects with filters, board and calendar layouts, Todoist Automations and AI-powered task capture. The Beginner plan is free; Pro costs $5 per month billed yearly for one user, and Business costs $8 per user per month billed yearly or $10 monthly.
pros: Apps for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, Apple Watch and WearOS
Unlimited AI-powered task capture, including Ramble, on Pro and Business
Todoist Automations with AI steps and approval steps on Pro and Business
SOC 2 Type II certification listed on all plans
cons: No timeline or Gantt view; layouts are list, board, calendar and table
No native time tracking; time tracking relies on the Toggl Track integration
Free Beginner plan is limited to 5 personal projects, 3 filters and 1 week of reporting history
freePlanDetails: Beginner: 5 personal projects, 5 people per personal project, 5 team projects, 3 custom filters, 1 connected calendar, 5 MB uploads, 1 week reporting history, 10 AI task capture sessions per month.

plans.name: Beginner
plans.notes: Free; 5 personal projects, 3 filters, no automations or calendar/table layouts.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Individual plan ($60 billed yearly), not priced per team seat. 300 personal projects, 150 filter views, 3 connected calendars, 100 MB uploads, full reporting history, automations (beta), auto backups.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per user ($96 per user billed yearly), plus local tax. Up to 500 team projects, 1,000 team members and guests, team roles and permissions, automations in the team workspace, centralized billing.

integrations: Toggl Track (time tracking), calendar sync, Todoist MCP servers

sources.label: Todoist help: use Toggl Track with Todoist
